overview: The file consists of eleven State Department jacket-index sheets summarizing correspondence, reports, clippings, translations, and cross-references concerning narcotics regulation and illicit drug traffic in the Kwantung Leased Territory, especially Dairen, from about 1930 through 1939, with references to earlier cases. Its entries document opium monopolies and addiction statistics, clandestine morphine factories, cocaine and “benzolin” smuggling, prosecutions and sentences, suspected international traffickers, and the movement of suspects among Dairen, Shanghai, Tientsin, Harbin, and other ports. The sheets also reveal sustained information-sharing among American consular posts, the State and Treasury Departments, the Bureau of Narcotics, foreign authorities, and the League of Nations.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: early narcotics correspondence concerning Dairen
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: An index sheet records early 1930 correspondence about illicit narcotics distribution and regulatory control in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: early despatches on Dairen opium distribution allegations, press reports, and an $800,000 Mukden seizure.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: prosecutions, benzolin, and the opium monopoly
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: A continuation index summarizes late-1930 and 1931 records on narcotics prosecutions, drug terminology, seizures, and the Kwantung opium monopoly.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Dairen's illicit opium trade linked to Hamburg and Japan, with indictments, a morphine seizure, and Osaka prosecutions.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: George I. Tribe and associated narcotics suspects, copy one
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: An index sheet catalogs correspondence on the arrest and investigation of George I. Tribe and other suspects in Dairen.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Tribe's arrest by Japanese authorities and associates including Koike, Sumida, Granovsky, Bogdanovsky, and Lelchitzky.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: George I. Tribe and associated narcotics suspects, duplicate sheet
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: A second version of the jacket sheet repeats and slightly revises entries on Tribe, his alleged associates, and the Bacri–Takashima case.
subfiles.summary: Duplicate sheet: variant suspect spellings, Tribe's trial opening, and his claim the transactions were purely local.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: Tribe investigation and secret morphine factory
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes 1932 correspondence on George I. Tribe, a clandestine Japanese morphine factory, and the Gourevich case.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Treasury's Tribe report, a secret Dairen morphine factory naming fourteen men, and cocaine-price inquiries.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: Fujita Shokai, Gourevich, and Dairen drug factories
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: An index sheet records late-1932 and early-1933 reports on cocaine purchasing, Gourevich, clandestine factories, and proposed Korean opium production.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Fujita Shokai's cocaine inquiry, Gourevich's sentence, Dairen morphine-factory suspects, and proposed Korean opium cultivation.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: 1932 Dairen cases, laws, budgets, and suspect movements
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: This sheet indexes reports on Fujita Shokai, Dairen narcotics cases, governing regulations, opium revenue, and the movements of suspects.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: 1932 Dairen narcotics cases, laws, Kwantung opium-monopoly budget, and suspect movements including Bogdanovsky's arrest.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: benzolin case and international suspect files
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: An index sheet covers reports on suspect movements, South Manchuria Railway opium regulations, the benzolin case, and Boris Bogdanovsky’s contacts.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Bacri-Takashima case reports, a benzolin-import retrial, and Tribe's passport and notebook contacts.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: morphine plants, foreign suspects, and maritime traffic
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes reports on Dairen morphine plants, suspect movements, Greek steamships, and narcotics manufacture and distribution.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: morphine plants, Dairen suspects Smith and the Kapustins, and Greek steamships linked to trafficking.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: regional narcotics reports and international intelligence
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: This index sheet records 1935–1937 reports on regional opium markets, smuggling, Chinese legislation, Dairen intelligence, and international suspects.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: regional opium-factory reports, Yokohama smuggling, a morphine-poisoning death, and Dairen visit reports.

subfiles.title: List of Papers: Kwantung opium monopoly and addiction statistics
subfiles.doc_type: list of papers / jacket index sheet
subfiles.about: The final index sheet catalogs 1938–1939 reports, ordinances, and statistics concerning the Kwantung Leased Territory opium monopoly.
subfiles.summary: List of papers: Kwantung's opium monopoly, ordinance translations, 28,197 licensed smokers, and 1937 trade statistics.

interest: Shows a decade of narcotics surveillance records on Dairen, naming suspects, shipping links, and opium-smoker statistics.
